content.css: .badge { position: absolute; left: 290px; top: 60px; width: 200px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 22px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; color: #FFFFFF; background: #F59E0B; letter-spacing: 2px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .steps { position: absolute; left: 40px; top: 130px; width: 700px; height: 280px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; grid-gap: 24px; padding: 0 20px; } .step { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 18px 24px; border-radius: 14px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); border: 1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.3); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(245,158,11,0.1); } .step .num { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F59E0B, #EF4444); color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 900; } .step .txt { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; color: #111827; letter-spacing: 2px; } .quote { position: absolute; left: 40px; top: 450px; width: 700px; height: 60px; margin: 0; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 900; color: #111827; line-height: 1.2; text-align: center; letter-spacing: 2px; text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(245,158,11,0.3); }
